name: Service_Appointment_Form
_about: Fields added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 Sorting Engine (05 Shared Engines / 01; Delivery 02 §2 'The delivery sorter') and the Site Requirements Checklist (Delivery 01). The Sorting Engine fields are written by the server (server/modules/delivery-management/sorter.mjs): a widget write to them is dropped. Site_Checklist is written by the widget (sales agent / dispatcher); Checklist_Complete and Checklist_Missing_Lines are computed by the server (server/modules/delivery-management/site-checklist.mjs) from it.

fields.name: Site_Checklist
fields.label: Site Requirements Checklist
fields.helpText: 12 lines (Delivery 01): one row per line, { Line, Status, Notes, Photo, Detail }. Detail carries what a Yes/No/N/A answer cannot: permit status/validity, ceiling metres, site hours, etc.

fields.name: Checklist_Complete
fields.label: Checklist Complete (lines 1-11)
fields.helpText: SR-R2: true once lines 1-11 are all answered. Server-only.

fields.name: Checklist_Missing_Lines
fields.label: Checklist Missing Lines
fields.helpText: SR-R2: the unanswered lines, by name, so the disabled hand-off button can name them. Server-only.

fields.name: Site_Hours_Warning
fields.label: Site Hours Warning
fields.helpText: SR-R5 [DEFAULT: warning only]: blank unless line 11's site working window is shorter than this job type's own duration. Server-only.

fields.name: Suggested_Crew_Size
fields.label: Suggested Crew Size
fields.helpText: SR-R6: '2-person' or '4-person', from checklist lines 8 (help on site) and 12 (boxes/lift). Server-only.

fields.name: Confirm_Appointment
fields.label: Confirm Appointment
fields.helpText: AP-R2: the widget sets this to true for 'the customer's reply, or a dispatcher call, sets confirmed'. Transient: the server stamps Appointment_Confirmed_At and clears this back to false on the same save.

fields.name: Appointment_Confirmed_At
fields.label: Appointment Confirmed At
fields.helpText: AP-R2/AP-R4: when the appointment was confirmed for its scheduled date (first write wins, never overwritten). Server-only.

fields.name: Box_Count
fields.label: Box Count
fields.helpText: Load sheet (Delivery 03 §2, LS-R2). Spec keeps box count per PACKAGE on the job; this app has no structured per-package breakdown on the appointment, so it is kept per JOB here — a simplification, see the Delivery review doc.

fields.name: Fragile
fields.label: Fragile
fields.helpText: LS-R2 load-sheet flag.

fields.name: Two_Person
fields.label: Two-Person Carry
fields.helpText: LS-R2 load-sheet flag.

fields.name: Crate_Marks
fields.label: Crate Marks
fields.helpText: LS-R2: free text, e.g. "This side up", "Fragile — glass".

fields.name: Dispatched_At
fields.label: Dispatched At
fields.helpText: DS-R3/G9: stamped when the day plan's gate passes. Server-only.

fields.name: Third_Party_Provider
fields.label: Third-Party Provider
fields.helpText: TP-R1, e.g. "Lalamove".

fields.name: Third_Party_Booking_Ref
fields.label: Third-Party Booking Reference
fields.helpText: TP-R1/G8: a third-party job's dispatch gate needs this instead of a driver signature.

fields.name: Third_Party_Fee
fields.label: Third-Party Delivery Fee
fields.helpText: TP-R1. Visible to dispatcher/supervisor/admin by the spec; this app has no field-level role masking yet, so it is stored but not hidden from anyone who can read the appointment.

fields.name: Third_Party_Driver_Name
fields.label: Third-Party Driver Name
fields.helpText: TP-R1, if given.

fields.name: Third_Party_Plate
fields.label: Third-Party Vehicle Plate
fields.helpText: TP-R1, if given.

fields.name: Third_Party_Result_Qty
fields.label: Third-Party Result (Quantities)
fields.helpText: TP-R4: free text, e.g. "10/10 delivered" — this app has no per-line item breakdown on an appointment to record true per-line quantities against.

fields.name: Third_Party_Photo
fields.label: Third-Party Delivery Photo
fields.helpText: TP-R2/TP-R4: the provider's proof-of-delivery photo URL.

fields.name: Third_Party_Left_At
fields.label: Third-Party Left At
fields.helpText: TP-R4: when the provider left, from their status or the dispatcher's entry — stored with the time we were told, not backdated.

fields.name: Third_Party_Done_At
fields.label: Third-Party Done At
fields.helpText: TP-R4.

fields.name: Third_Party_Proof_Confirmed
fields.label: Third-Party Customer Confirmation Received
fields.helpText: TP-R2: 'the customer's confirmation (link)' completes the proof. No tracking page/token exists in this app yet (see the Delivery review doc, §4.6) — a dispatcher sets this by hand until that is built; it is not a real customer-facing link.

fields.name: Job_Status
fields.label: Job Status
fields.helpText: Delivery 03's job status chain, computed by server/modules/delivery-management/job-status.mjs from fields this app already stamps. Server-only; sits alongside Appointment_Status, does not replace it.

fields.name: Job_Arrived_At
fields.label: Job Arrived At
fields.helpText: The on_site stamp: Field_Work's own 'Status: Started' save (the nearest existing 'first action at the site' signal — no field app yet to fire the real one). First write wins. Server-only.

fields.name: Job_Archived_At
fields.label: Job Archived At
fields.helpText: Stamped by the nightly Archive_Delivery_Jobs_Daily job, archive_after_days after a Completed/Failed job was last touched. Server-only.

fields.name: Job_Done_At
fields.label: Job Done At
fields.helpText: The done stamp: first time Appointment_Status became Completed/Failed. First write wins. Server-only.

fields.name: Failure_Reason_Code
fields.label: Failure Reason Code
fields.helpText: Delivery 05's failure reason codes [DEFAULT list, Admin-editable via Delivery_Failure_Reasons]. Set once, when the job is marked failed/partial, by createRedeliveryJob() or forceCloseJob().

fields.name: Failure_Notes
fields.label: Failure Notes
fields.helpText: Required when Failure_Reason_Code is "other".

fields.name: Broken_Redelivery
fields.label: Broken Redelivery
fields.helpText: FR-R2: true on a redelivery job created because the original was damaged in transit or refused — the sorting engine (sorter.mjs) reads this to put it in the Broken category. Server-only.

fields.name: Force_Closed
fields.label: Force Closed
fields.helpText: FR-R5: the dispatcher closed this job by hand (phone died / team could not submit) instead of a normal close-out. Goes to the supervisor's Approval_Queue (Kind force_close) for after-the-fact review.

fields.name: Time_Window
fields.label: Time Window
fields.helpText: Delivery 03: the window the customer is told (Morning or Afternoon, from the workday times), instead of the exact Confirmed_Time_Slot. Computed by the server (time-window.mjs); a widget cannot write it.

fields.name: Books_Payment_Status
fields.label: Books Payment Status
fields.helpText: G3 (pre-delivery gate): paid, unpaid or unknown, as Books last answered. Server-only; kept for 60 minutes (Books_Payment_Checked_At).

fields.name: Books_Payment_Checked_At
fields.label: Books Payment Checked At
fields.helpText: G3: when Books was last asked about payment. The gate re-asks only after 60 minutes.

fields.name: Site_Visit_Blocking_Findings
fields.label: Site Visit Blocking Findings
fields.helpText: SV-R3: carried over from an earlier Site Visit appointment for the same Sales Order, for the sales agent. Server-only.
